about: Leonida Ledger data file. Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list as published; hidden flags and progress targets follow the same published list. Every guide below is written for this app and cites where its facts come from.

sources.exophase: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list: official names, descriptions and grades
sources.psnprofiles: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list: progress targets and rarity
sources.powerpyx: PowerPyx — GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap
sources.truetrophies: TrueTrophies — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guides

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum. It unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all on your profile, so there is nothing separate to chase: work the roadmap in this app, keep the one missable (Positive Mental Attitude) in mind while you roam, and let the 100% completion trophy be your final long haul.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It cannot be missed: play the prologue as either character and the trophy pops when the mission wraps up. If you are starting a fresh save, this is simply the first trophy almost every player earns.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 1 and this unlocks at the chapter's end. Story chapters cannot be skipped or failed permanently, so no preparation is needed; just follow the mission markers until the chapter closes.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 of the story. The name is printed exactly as PlayStation publishes it, asterisks included. Like the other chapter trophies it is unmissable: finish the chapter's last mission and it unlocks during the wrap-up.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. By this point the map and most side content are open, but the trophy itself only asks for the chapter's missions: keep following the story markers and it unlocks when the chapter ends.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale. Unmissable like the other chapter trophies: finish its closing mission and the trophy is yours.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The gold for finishing the story's final mission. Whatever choices the finale offers, completing the mission itself is what counts, so play it through to the credits. It pairs naturally with the chapter trophies on the road to A Long Road.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is part of the main mission chain, so it cannot be missed or locked out; the trophy unlocks as the mission completes.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist, one of the story's set-piece heists. Heist missions sit on the main path, so simply reach and complete it; your approach and take do not matter for the trophy.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It is on the critical path and unmissable; the trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. As with the other named-mission trophies, this one is tied to story progress and cannot be missed; complete the mission and it unlocks.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, the story mission set around Vice City International Airport. It is part of the main chain, so reaching and finishing the mission is all that is required.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable and on the main path: the trophy unlocks when the operation is complete.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The second gold, and the real marathon: reach 100% on the in-game completion counter. The counter draws on story, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and exploration, so use this tracker's filters as your checklist and mop up by category. PlayStation tracks progress to 100, and the last few percent are usually collectibles and one-off activities rather than story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 of the game's stunt jumps. Stunts are one-shot landmarks scattered over Leonida: hit the ramp or gap at speed and land cleanly on all wheels to bank it. Work region by region and keep a vehicle with good acceleration handy; failed attempts can simply be retried on the spot. PlayStation counts each completed stunt toward 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type once: PlayStation counts 9 types. You only have to start and finish one session of each kind (races, fishing, arcade games and the rest as they appear on the map), not master them, so sweep this up early while you explore and it will also teach you what the other activity trophies ask for.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each range scores accuracy and speed per weapon class, and challenges can be replayed freely, so learn a course's target order first and then push for pace. Max out the relevant weapon stats and keep your best-scoring weapon for each class; golds tend to fall once the pattern is memorised.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. You only need one win per location, not a medal sweep, so retry a course until its line through the gates feels automatic, then move on. Cutting corners inside gates counts as long as you pass through them in order.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; repeats of the same race do not add to the count. Mix street, off-road and water events as they unlock, bring the fastest vehicle each class allows, and save the hardest courses for after your driving stats and garage have grown.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Out-fish Cal in one of his fishing challenges. Accept the challenge when it is offered at the fishing spots, then land the heavier catch inside the time limit: use the best bait you own, cast to the ripples, and play the fish steadily rather than reeling flat out, which snaps lines.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game on any cabinet in Leonida. Pick the shortest game you find, play it to its end screen (win or lose, completion is what counts), and the trophy unlocks. It also ticks one of the nine activity types for Master of None.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's strand by completing his final mission. Character strands advance as you visit their markers between story missions; if Andy's last job has not appeared yet, progress the story and keep answering his calls and texts until it does.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission to close his strand. Work his jobs in order as they appear on the map; the strand's last mission is the one that pays this trophy, and it stays available until you take it.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand with his final mission. Keep clearing his markers when they surface between story beats; the last job in his chain unlocks this trophy on completion.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands anywhere in Leonida. A strand only counts when its final mission is done, so finish chains rather than sampling first jobs: the named characters in this list (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and others) each contribute one. PlayStation tracks the count to 8.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Follow his strand to its end as his jobs appear; finishing the last one unlocks the trophy and also moves Strangers & Freaks one step closer.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand by completing his final mission. His jobs appear across the middle of the game; clear them in order and the strand's last mission pays the trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — the one trophy in this list that can be locked out. Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida (PlayStation counts to 18). The catch, per the official description and the guides tracking it: some spots sit in places the story changes or closes off as chapters advance, so visit each region's spots before pushing its chapter finale, and keep a backup save before the final missions. If a spot is still reachable in free roam afterwards, finish it there; if your save has passed the point of no return for one, a fresh playthrough is the fallback. Do not leave this until after the credits without checking your spots first.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take Bret's contract and hunt the unique animal he names. Work his strand until the hunt unlocks, then track the animal in its home region: approach downwind, use the best rifle you own, and land a clean shot so the pelt and the kill both register.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida in shops, bars and landmarks; a set only counts when every card in it is in your collection, so hunt set by set instead of grabbing at random. This is also where the roadmap's step 2 sends you: the story route passes most of the 15 target decks' hunting grounds, so sweep cards while the map is fresh in your mind.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It spot at 100 different locations. These marked spots are spread over the whole state, so treat this as a tour: clear them district by district alongside exploration for The Goodtime State, and let PlayStation's counter (to 100) be your progress check.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 of the game's Challenges. Challenges are the short scored tasks offered by contacts and notice boards; they can be retried freely and most take minutes, so batch them whenever you pass a hub and the count to 50 climbs quickly.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, raise a 4-star wanted level, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars drain completely. Alleys, parking structures and a quick vehicle swap all help; the trophy needs the escape finished while your partner is still with you, so do not split up mid-chase.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner, keeping a wanted level alive the whole time: the chain breaks if the stars fully clear between shops. Pick a tight cluster of stores, keep moving, and take the third till while the heat from the first two is still on you.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles: a vehicle counts the first time you get in and drive it. Busy districts, marinas, airports and rich neighbourhoods each spawn different pools, so steal widely as you travel and the counter (to 100) fills largely on its own.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies inside one activation of Combat Focus. Set it up where enemies cluster (a gang operation or a busy shootout), weaken a group first if needed, then trigger Focus and sweep targets head-first. If a run ends at four, reload the encounter and retry with a fuller magazine.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, take off in an aircraft without clearance: steal a plane from the apron or a hangar and get airborne. Expect an instant wanted level, so line up on the longest runway and climb straight out over the water.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: No published method yet. The official description ('Kinda hot in these Rhinos') points at the Rhino tank, but as of this guide's writing neither the trophy lists nor the guide sites we cite have confirmed the exact trigger — surviving inside a Rhino, destroying one, and escaping the military response are the community's working theories, none verified. We will not invent steps: check the cited lists for the confirmed method, and treat anything more specific as unproven until they agree.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and get out unseen: no alarm, no witnesses, no wanted level. Go in quiet, keep the staff covered without firing, watch the door for passers-by, and leave by the back if the store has one. If detection triggers, let the attempt go and try another store rather than forcing it.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one; a vault only counts once you have lost the heat that follows. Bring your best crew gear, plan the exit vehicle before you go in, and vary your targets so police response patterns stay manageable. PlayStation counts the escapes to 5.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hold up an armored truck and escape with the take. Hit it on a quiet stretch, crack the rear doors fast (heavy firepower or explosives), grab the cash, and swap vehicles once to break the pursuit. One clean job is all the trophy asks.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. An area counts once you have physically been there, so finish with a deliberate sweep of the map's unvisited corners — the keys, the farmland and the northern coast are the usual stragglers. Pair the sweep with You WAiNKer! spots to make one tour pay for both.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation owned by each of the 9 gangs. Operations are marked once scouted; vary your targets by gang rather than farming one, and keep a fast car outside — the owners respond in force. PlayStation tracks one robbery per gang toward 9.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach. Head to the Ocean Beach strip, order a drink at one of the open-air bars overlooking the water, and let the animation finish; the trophy is a quiet nod to where the series' Vice City story began.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car out through a vehicle showroom's glass front. Take any showroom car (or your own), line up with the windows, and accelerate straight through them onto the street; the trophy wants the smash, not a getaway, so the wanted level afterwards is your own problem.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through on your throw. Visit the alley, start a game, and complete a delivery with a proper follow-through motion; one qualifying throw is enough, and the visit also counts toward the activity types in Master of None.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: No published method yet. The official description ('A partnership with mass appeal') is deliberately cryptic, and none of the lists or guide sites cited here has confirmed what action unlocks it — speculation links it to a public stunt performed with your partner, but nothing is verified. Rather than guess, we flag it plainly: watch the cited sources for the confirmed trigger.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: No published method yet. PlayStation tracks a counter to 500 against the description 'Choices made (for better or worse)', which suggests a long grind of in-game decisions, but the lists and guides cited here have not confirmed which actions increment it or whether 500 is reachable in one playthrough. We state the target honestly and do not pad it with invented steps; check the cited lists for the confirmed method.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No published method yet. 'Second time's the charm' implies failing at something and succeeding on the retry, but no cited source has confirmed which activity, race or mission it belongs to. Until Exophase, PSNProfiles or the guide sites agree on the trigger, any more specific instruction would be a guess, so we leave it marked as unconfirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: No published method yet. The description ('What the hell just happened?') points to a strange scripted encounter or Easter egg somewhere in Leonida, but its location and trigger are unconfirmed by every source we cite. We will not point you at a made-up spot: when the guide sites pin it down, this entry's sources are where the confirmation will appear.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock a pedestrian down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Drive slowly past someone on a sidewalk, swing as you pass, and make contact without running them over outright — the hit has to be the melee strike. A motorcycle at walking pace gives the cleanest timing.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and operations; hand them to a laundering contact rather than spending them raw, and the cleaned total accumulates toward 250,000. It pairs with a robbery-heavy route: Maximum Withdrawal and Pest Control feed it steadily.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops: clothes, weapons, vehicle work, food and services all count. There is no trick to it — buy what your playthrough needs, top up with ammunition and outfits late in the game, and the counter (to 100,000) completes itself.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties on the map. Garages unlock for purchase as the story opens new districts; keep a cash reserve from heists and laundering so price is never the blocker, and buy each one as you reach its neighbourhood.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. When you find a vehicle worth keeping, open the app and register it on the spot; ten registrations is a small ask spread over a playthrough, and it overlaps naturally with discovering vehicles for Whip It Good.
